note: v3359: ⚠⚠⚠ THIS REVERTS v3358 BECAUSE v3358 OVERTURNED A RULING HE GAVE TWICE, AND IT DID SO ON A MEASUREMENT I CREATED MYSELF. v3289 records his words: the row where it says BEST RUN MOST READS TOP READS BEST COVERAGE AND STREAK i want at the tippy top of the SHELF TAB above the sessions reels, and then, and the activity i want uptop under the BEST RUNS row. That request reopens the v2985 scar ON PURPOSE and pays for it with window._shOpenOnAReel, an opening-scroll guard re-run AFTER _shTimeline so the shelf still opens ON A REEL. v3289 measured both states at his real 1120x660: order alone gives scrollTop 0, firstCardTop 815, not visible; order plus guard gives scrollTop 476, firstCardTop 235, VISIBLE. HOW I GOT IT WRONG, exactly: my probe measured his live console and read scrollTop 497 with the first card at 211 - the guard working - and I then made the probe RESET scrollTop to 0 to see what he sees when it opens, measured 708 in a 660 viewport, and reordered the shelf to put the list first. The 708 was mine. Worse, when I later put that reset inside a polling loop the probe rewrote the scroll every 0.7 seconds and then reported the zero it had just written as the console own state - a gate perturbing what it measures, twice in one session, in the same instrument. v3289 own law went red the moment v3358 landed and named the ruling I had broken. THE PROBE NO LONGER WRITES, and the honest reading on the restored order is scrollTop 497, first card top 211, twelve cards, OPENS ON A REEL - confirmed on the pixels, not the rectangles. WHAT IS RESTORED: the assembly is back to highlights, ACTIVITY, cards, lanes, story, byte-identical to v3357. WHAT IS RETIRED, DELIBERATELY: three ordering cases across the two v2985-era laws - the grid-before-every-analytic-block case, the cards-before-every-analytic-block case and the activity-leads-the-band case. They encode a ruling he overturned, they had been red on BOTH venues since v3289, and making them green is only possible by breaking his shelf. The authority on shelf order is test_the_shelf_opens_on_a_reel and both docstrings now say so. Everything in those laws that is NOT about order survives: nothing dropped, the controls preceding the list, the badge facts. WHAT I KEEP FROM v3358 because it was real: the _assembly window helper was reading 1,700 of 13,121 characters because its end anchor was a semicolon-newline that fires inside an inline function in the head, so three cases reported that the grid and the river strip had been REMOVED from a page they were sitting in; it now ends at the first operand line at the chain own six-space indent and REFUSES rather than reporting an absence. And the badge-tooltip case asserted the bare name b.title, which occurs 5 times in control_ui.html while the guarded statement occurs once, so its own red-proof deleted the real line and stayed GREEN; it asserts the full expression now. TWO MORE REDS CLOSED, both venue-independent: engine_index.json still carried a curated entry for prune_wilson.py, a module my own v3347 deleted, and the blueprint was correctly printing it as STALE every render; and the river harness never declared SHELF_POP, a page-level name the extracted block acquired in v3279, so node threw and four cases failed on both venues about code that is correct on the page - declared at its shipped initial value beside SHELF_MOUTH, which is the same dependency one version earlier. AND THE FLEET, from his report this hour: Dean columns 2 and 3 read not published - no board window. MEASURED live: theirHave 131 of 135 with maskWhy no board window, against mineNames 133 and mineWhy null, and Dean last beacon 9h27m old on v3342. The publisher is NOT broken - it carries the iframe hop and is byte-identical since v3342 - but its give-up collapses two different states into one unactionable string. _MAIN_WIN is None on the headless path that the console supervisor revives with, and a console with no native window can COUNT its pieces forever and never NAME one; opening a board page cannot change that. The reason now says which, and the actionable one says relaunch it WITH a window. That string already travels to the panel as maskWhy. HEART: the doctor row v3358 added asserted the OPPOSITE of his ruling and is inverted here - it watches HIS order AND the scroll guard that pays for it, going MISSING if the order drifts or if the guard stops being re-run after the chart fills, which is the state that would put furniture on his screen and no reels. 3 ms, proven red on both failure shapes. 478 gates, 1,069 red-proofs in the tree and every one well formed.
